section: Kansas corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Corporate income tax normal rate
note: Cut from the statutory 4% to 3.5% from Jan 1, 2024 under the APEX Act (K.S.A. 74-50,321). No further cut for tax year 2026 was found.
source_title: Kansas Register Vol. 42 No. 35 (Aug 31, 2023), Kansas Department of Revenue: Notice of Corporate Income Tax Normal Rate Reduction

section: Kansas corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Additional corporate tax on taxable income over $50,000
note: Kansas calls this the corporate surtax; it is added to the normal rate on income above $50,000 (combined 6.5%).
source_title: Kansas Office of Revisor of Statutes: K.S.A. 79-32,110 (c) Corporations

section: Kansas corporate income and franchise taxes
label: Bank privilege tax rates
value: 1.94% of net income plus 2.125% on net income over $25,000
note: National and state banks pay this privilege tax instead of the corporate income tax (K.S.A. 79-1107), for tax year 2024 and later.
source_title: Kansas Office of Revisor of Statutes: K.S.A. 79-1107

label: Levied by
value: Cities, townships, school districts and other taxing subdivisions (collected by the county treasurer)
note: Counties also levy; each body certifies its levy to the county clerk by October 1.
source_title: Kansas Office of Revisor of Statutes: K.S.A. 79-1801

label: State oversight
value: Kansas Department of Revenue, Division of Property Valuation (Director of Property Valuation)
note: The division's page (ksrevenue.gov/pvd.html) could not be reached; duties quoted from statute.
source_title: Kansas Office of Revisor of Statutes: K.S.A. 75-5105a Director of property valuation; powers and duties

label: Residential assessment rate
note: Homes are taxed on 11.5% of appraised market value; commercial/industrial real property 25%, farmland (use value) 30%.
source_title: Kansas Office of Revisor of Statutes: K.S.A. 79-1439

label: State property tax levies
value: 1.5 mills statewide (1 mill for higher education + 0.5 mill for state institutions); plus a mandatory 20-mill school levy for 2025-26 and 2026-27 remitted to the state
note: The compiled statutes name levy year 2025 for the 1 and 0.5 mill state levies (K.S.A. 76-6b01, 76-6b04); the 20 mills is K.S.A. 72-5142.
source_title: Kansas Office of Revisor of Statutes: K.S.A. 76-6b01 (also 76-6b04 and 72-5142)

label: Mortgage registration tax
value: None since 2019: repealed (was 0.26% of the mortgage principal)
note: Phased out 2015-2018 and repealed from calendar year 2019; recording fees were raised instead.
source_title: Kansas Legislative Research Department: Mortgage Registration Tax and Statutory Fees for Recording Documents with County Registers of Deeds
